grounding.exactText: Job Title: Producr Growth Head - Spice Money
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Location: Noida
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Experience: 5 to 8 Years
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Education: B.Tech/Post Graduate from Top Tier Institute
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Our Story:Founded in 2000 by Dilip Modi, Spice Money Limited is India’s leading rural fintech company, headquartered in Noida and operating as a subsidiary of DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited, a publicly listed entity.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: The company is driven by a strong mission to accelerate financial inclusion and empower the underserved “Bharat” through technology-enabled financial services.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: With a network of 1.6+ million Adhikaris across India, the company enables last-mile access to essential services including AEPS cash withdrawal and deposits, domestic money transfer, bill payments, insurance, micro-ATM services, credit solutions, travel bookings, account opening, and UPI-led digital payments.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: Spice Money has consistently introduced industry-first innovations such as a zero-cost Adhikari platform, one of India’s largest assisted payments networks, a rural credit marketplace, and Spice Money UPI & Spice Pay wallet to accelerate digital adoption in smaller towns and villages.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: Operating across 95%+ pincodes with a team of 1,000+ employees, Spice Money combines the agility of a high-growth fintech with the scale and impact of a nationwide distribution network—creating meaningful economic opportunities and driving the next phase of financial inclusion in India.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: The Impact You'll Create:The Growth Head– B2B (Spice Money) will act as the digital business manager for the company’s core assisted financial services.
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: This is a business-first role responsible for managing agent engagement, retention, cross-product penetration and satisfaction through digital levers such as communication, incentive design, structured lifecycle programs and sentiment monitoring.
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: You will work closely with the product, business, CRM, creative and analytics teams to identify friction points, drive usage and scale partner contribution to revenue through structured and data-backed initiatives.
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Success in this role is characterized by the following milestones:Improved revenue contribution per active Adhikari (month-on-month growth)
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Activation of >3 products per agent within 90 days of onboarding
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Net Retention Rate (NRR) uplift through structured lifecycle management
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Reduction in inactive agents by >30% over 2 quarters
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Measurable improvement in partner NPS/SAT scores within 6 months
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: High adoption of VIP/Loyalty programs with >50% participation from top agents
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: How Will You Contribute:Build and manage the digital growth roadmap for AEPS, DMT, BBPS, CMS and other revenue-generating verticals within Spice Money
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Own digital engagement with SMAs (Spice Money Adhikaris), their retention, productivity metrics and GTV and revenue across core services
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Own digital engagement with SMAs (Spice Money Adhikaris), their retention, productivity metrics and GTV and revenue across core services
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Design and deploy structured lifecycle programs (SMS, Whats
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: App, product journeys (along with product teams) in-app nudges, notifications) to improve product usage and cross-adoption
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Improve penetration of VIP loyalty program for high-performing agents to increase stickiness and lifetime value
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Own the NPS/SAT feedback loop, run monthly sentiment trackers and drive continuous improvement
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Partner with analytics to build product usage cohorts and lifecycle drop-off reports and course correct
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Optimize pricing and commission structures using feedback and data to increase adoption
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Create monthly growth dashboards and market intelligence bulletins for internal stakeholders
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: You're A Great Fit If You: Deep understanding of B2B growth and lifecycle marketing in digitally assisted ecosystems
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Experience with agent-led or distribution-based models, ideally in fintech, payments, or rural.
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Strong command over digital communication tools, user segmentation and campaign management
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Ability to translate on-ground feedback into structured product or pricing interventions
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Proficiency in data-driven growth: Google Sheets, Tableau, CRM dashboards, Excel-based modeling
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Strong stakeholder management, structured thinking, and execution bias
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: This role is for someone who understands Bharat deeply and can build scalable, structured, and data-led growth programs for a distributed, digitally assisted ecosystem.
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: If you’re passionate about solving for India’s next 500 million users—this is your canvas.
grounding.subject: COMPANY
